hook.title: Platform Dutch
hook.content: De trein komt aan, het station is hier, ik heb een ticket, wij stappen over. Travel Dutch is a set of arrival and transfer frames.

pattern.title: Arrive, have, transfer
pattern.content: Aankomen is separable: de trein komt aan. Overstappen is separable: wij stappen over. Hebben covers the ticket; zijn covers the location.
pattern.trap_note: Overstappen means changing trains, not stepping over something. The separable prefix over carries the meaning.

exercises.prompt: Match each English meaning with its Dutch twin (De Trein & Het Ticket):
exercises.target_answer: de trein, het station, het ticket, de fiets, overstappen, aankomen
exercises.meaning: train, station, ticket, bicycle, to change trains, to arrive
exercises.explanation: These are the anchors of "De Trein & Het Ticket": read each Dutch form through the pattern, not as a new word.
“De trein komt aan.” is the Dutch form; the other readings bend the pattern of “De Trein & Het Ticket”.

cues: It means: The station is here.
exercises.explanation: “Het station is hier.” puts the thought together the Dutch way — Arrive, have, transfer.

diagnosis.slip: an English-shaped word order slipped in
diagnosis.cue: Overstappen means changing trains, not stepping over something. The separable prefix over carries the meaning.

exercises.prompt: Which English sentence is built the Dutch way?
exercises.explanation: “Ik heb een ticket.” is word-for-word “I have a ticket.”. The odd English is the lesson — never a model to produce. Pattern: Arrive, have, transfer.

exercises.prompt: Listen and write the whole sentence.
exercises.explanation: “Wij stappen over.” reuses only material taught in “De Trein & Het Ticket” — Arrive, have, transfer.
exercises.affirmation: You heard “Wij stappen over.” — a sentence built from the lesson's own Dutch, practising Arrive, have, transfer.

twist.prompt: One more, no safety net — say: “I go by bike.”
twist.explanation: Met + transport is the Dutch 'by' phrase; fiets is the everyday bicycle.

summary.outcome: Navigate a Dutch station with arrival, ticket and transfer sentences.
summary.takeaway: Travel verbs are often separable; the prefix carries the direction.
summary.curiosity_teaser: Up next on De Brug: Moeder, Vader & Leraar.

trein.etymology_derivation: The same French loan as English train.

station.etymology_derivation: The same Latin loan as English station.

ticket.etymology_derivation: A recent English loan, little changed.

fiets.etymology_derivation: A Dutch word of uncertain origin; the everyday bicycle.
